title: [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois..., pages 650 bis à 787, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is the end of a verification that begins on p.783 of §E of the 'suite à La Longue Marche' notes. It concludes just before §F (p.784), 'interprétation différentielle des groupes de Teichmüller spéciaux'.

Setting. x is a point of a surface with a C^1 structure near x. S_x is the circle of tangent directions at x, and S_x^~ is its universal cover. D_x^* is the germ of punctured disc at x, and D_x^{*~} is its universal cover. A ranges over the set 𝒜_x of (proper, connected) open arcs of S_x. Ep(A) is the corresponding germ of sector in D_x^*.

The correlation h_x matches sections α of S_x^~ over A with sections β of D_x^{*~} over Ep(A). Concretely, a choice of branch of argument on the arc corresponds to a choice of branch on the sector. Both coverings are torsors under T_x ≅ π_1 ≅ Z, and the correlation is T_x-equivariant.

For a germ of C^1 isomorphism u: (X,x) → (X',x'), equation (120) is the canonical bijection between two sets:
- lifts u_{S^~}: S_x^~ → S_{x'}^~ of the differential, and
- lifts u_{D^{*~}}: D_x^{*~} → D_{x'}^{*~} of the induced map on punctured discs.
On p.783 it is built through the Isom-torsor diagram (122) and characterised by property (123): lifts associated by (120) carry h_x-correlated sections to h'-correlated sections.

This page proves that (123) actually characterises and constructs (120).
- Fix A and a section α over A, and fix a lift u_{S^~}.
- Let β = h_x(α), α' = u_{S^~}(α), and β' = h'(α').
- The condition u_{D^{*~}}(β) = β' pins down u_{D^{*~}} uniquely. A deck-type lift of a map between universal covers is determined by where it sends a single section over a connected set.

The NB then argues that this recipe, for fixed (A, α), defines a T_x-equivariant map between T_x-torsors. Such a map is automatically bijective, and being canonical it does not depend on α (changing α by t ∈ T_x changes everything equivariantly).

Independence of A needs checking. For A ⊂ A' the two recipes agree, because one can restrict sections. The equivalence relation on 𝒜_x generated by inclusion is the coarse (total) relation: any two arcs are linked by a chain of inclusions through small sub-arcs and a common larger arc. Hence the map is independent of A.

The purpose is to make rigorous the identification between 'tangential' data (tangent circle) and 'punctured disc' data at a marked point. This is needed for the differential interpretation of Teichmüller groups of surfaces with marked points in §F.
errors: No mathematical error. Two minor gaps:
The chain argument needs the arcs to be proper (A ≠ the whole circle), so that sections of the universal covers exist over Ep(A).
The chain argument also needs a common larger arc to exist; both points are implicit but harmless.

ideas.what: Canonical correspondence between lifts to the universal cover of the tangent circle and lifts to the universal cover of the punctured disc germ, via sector/arc correlation
ideas.modern_name: tangential base points / identification of the 'tangent circle' with the boundary circle of the real oriented blow-up (Kato–Nakayama-type log geometry)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Deligne (tangential base points, 1989); real oriented blow-up: A'Campo, Kato–Nakayama
ideas.where_published: La Longue Marche (1981, circulated) treats Teichmüller groupoids and marked points; this precise construction is unsure

ideas.what: Uniqueness of a lift of a map between universal covers given the image of one section over a connected set; equivariant map of torsors is an isomorphism
Independence of an auxiliary choice via connectedness of the poset of choices (equivalence relation generated by inclusion is coarse)
ideas.modern_name: connectedness of an indexing category / colimit over a connected poset

deep.surprise_reason: This is a routine well-definedness check (independence of α and of A) inside the construction relating tangent-direction circles to punctured-disc germs. The surrounding theme anticipates tangential base points, but this page adds nothing beyond standard torsor arguments.
transcription_corrections: 'Ceci [-construit-] Garantit' → likely 'Ceci [-construit-] garantit'; possibly '(170)' should read '(120)', since the bijection in question is (120) from p.783 (both occurrences).
'car pour u_{D^*} fixé' → 'car pour u_{S^~} fixé' (the lift on the tangent-circle side is fixed).
'α' déduit de α par u_D' → 'par u_{S^~}'.
'β' déduit de α' par h_{α'}' → 'par h_{x'}' (or h').
'en identifiant u_{D^*} à D_α^* → D_{α'}^α' → 'en appliquant u_{D^{*~}}: D_x^{*~} → D_{x'}^{*~}'.
'Mais a priori il dépend' → 'Mais a priori elle dépend'.
'pour A et A' distincts [?]' → roughly 'pour A et A' dans 𝒜_x avec A ⊂ A''.
'engendrée par A_α par la relation d'inclusion' → 'engendrée dans 𝒜_x par la relation d'inclusion'.
'd'où ce résultat de suite' → likely 'entraîne le résultat'.
